data.narrative:
Resolute Grid is a seed-stage company operating in Climate & Energy, a sector with limited comparable public benchmarks (1 public company: LNZA) and 8 identifiable private peers including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Standard peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable to this target. The Climate & Energy comparable universe contains 8 private companies, but none meet simultaneous filtering criteria for stage alignment, valuation tier proximity, or business model similarity. A same-stage, narrow-peer median would require a minimum of three datapoints; the available set yields zero matches when restricted to seed-stage or adjacent-stage competitors with comparable valuation tiers. Applying an all-sector median across the 8 private peers would introduce substantial heterogeneity bias, as these companies span different development stages and technology domains within climate and energy.

The lack of sufficient stage-matched comparables limits traditional triangulation approaches. Valuation of Resolute Grid would require supplementary methods not present in the current dataset—such as discounted cash flow modeling with sector-specific discount rates, venture-backed cost-of-capital frameworks, or reference to the broader Climate & Energy venture market. The public benchmark (LNZA) offers sector context but insufficient precision for seed-stage pricing. Without additional proprietary financial data on the peer set or management guidance on Resolute Grid's specific business metrics, a defensible valuation range cannot be established from peer analysis alone.
